title: Understanding the Gradient Descent Update
text: In stochastic gradient descent, the update rule for a parameter \( $$\theta$$ \) is given by \( \theta**{(t+1)} $$=$$ \theta**{(t)} - \alpha \cdot \text{gradient} \). Think about how this formula applies to \( $$\theta_1$$ \) in this problem.

title: Calculate the Gradient for \( $$\theta_1$$ \)
text: To find the gradient for \( $$\theta_1$$ \), use the partial derivative given: \( \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}**{n}(-\frac{x_i}{\theta_1} + $$\theta_0$$ $${x_i}^2$$ + \theta_0) \). Substitute \( $$x_i$$ $$=$$ $$2$$ \), \( $$\theta_0$$ $$=$$ $$4$$ \), and \( $$\theta_1$$ $$=$$ $$1$$ \) to find the gradient value.

title: Calculate the Gradient Value
text: What is the value of the gradient for \( $$\theta_1$$ \) when \( $$x_i$$ $$=$$ $$2$$ \), \( $$\theta_0$$ $$=$$ $$4$$ \), and \( $$\theta_1$$ $$=$$ $$1$$ \)?

title: Using the Update Rule
text: Now that you have the gradient, use the update rule \( \theta_1**{(1)} $$=$$ \theta_1**{(0)} - \alpha \cdot \text{gradient} \) to find the learning rate \( \alpha \). You know \( \theta_1**{(1)} $$=$$ $$-5$$ \) and \( \theta_1**{(0)} $$=$$ $$1$$ \).

title: Solve for the Learning Rate
text: Using the equation \( $$-5$$ $$=$$ $$1$$ - \alpha \cdot $$(-12)$$ \), what is the value of \( \alpha \)?
